definitions.explanation: A person one works with at the same company or organization.

examples.japanese: {同僚|どうりょう}と{昼|ひる}ごはんを{食|た}べました。
examples.english: I had lunch with my colleague.

examples.japanese: {同僚|どうりょう}はみんな{親切|しんせつ}です。
{新|あたら}しい{同僚|どうりょう}が{入|はい}ってきました。

notes: 同僚 combines 同 (same) and 僚 (companion). It specifically refers to coworkers at the same level or in the same organization. It doesn't include superiors (上司) or subordinates (部下).
